item.title: Acupressure for Learning Disorders Using a Mental Health Point
item.description: Learn a special point that clears the mind and helps both children and adults concentrate and focus more easily. It promotes calmness and mental stability.

item.title: Holistic Acupressure Ear Point, Shen Men for Longevity, Pain & Addiction
item.description: Demonstrates an Acupressure ear point for wellness, called Shen Men. Shen Men is a profound, empowering marvelous point for heightening your body’s overall wellness.

item.title: Acupressure Digestive Aid Point Sp 16
item.description: Sp 16, known as the “Abdominal Sorrow” point, relieves many kinds of indigestion, such as abdominal cramps, acid stomach, gas pain, rib pain, hiccups, and ulcer pain.

item.title: Acupressure for Lower Backaches, Fatigue and Exhaustion
item.description: Watch a video demonstration of an Acupressure massage technique that relieves chronic fatigue, exhaustion, and lower backaches, and boosts immunity.

item.title: Acupressure Foot Pain Points Lv 3 & GB 41
item.description: Discover two pain relief trigger points for arthritis relief, fibromyalgia pain relief, muscular spasms and chronic muscular aches and pains.

item.title: Acupressure Points for Stress Relief — Shoulder & Neck Tension
item.description: Watch a video to see how to relieve and manage stress using Acupressure points GB 20, GB 21, B 10 and GV 16, for releasing shoulder tension and neck pain. Includes illustrated directions.

item.title: Ear Acupressure Massage Reflexology Points for Wellness & Self-Healing
item.description: Videos from Michael Reed Gach, Ph.D. demo how to stimulate 150 ear Acupressure points, which provide therapeutic health benefits for wellness.

item.title: Acupressure Points for Brain & Memory
item.description: Learn easy and effective Acupressure techniques for better memory, mental focus, recovery from injuries and headaches.

item.title: Michael Gach's Acupressure Teachers & Creating Acu-Yoga
item.description: Personal stories from Acupressure expert Michael Reed Gach, Ph.D. about studying Jin Shin Jyutsu with his first Acupressure teachers Ron and Iona Teeguarden in the 1970s.

item.title: Acu-Yoga: Self-Healing Techniques
item.description: Acu-Yoga is based upon centuries of practice and research in Asia. It’s a system of exercises that integrates the knowledge of two ancient holistic self-healing practices — Acupressure and Yoga.
